chunks.speaker: A
chunks.text: Okay so I finally tried making that dish we had in Lisbon, the one with the clams and the sausage.

chunks.speaker: B
chunks.text: Oh my gosh, the Cata Plana thing. How did it turn out?

chunks.speaker: A
chunks.text: Honestly, way better than I expected. Not as good as that little place near the river, but pretty close.

chunks.speaker: B
chunks.text: See, I still think about that restaurant. What was it called again, something with an alley in the name?

chunks.speaker: A
chunks.text: Alphama, that's the neighborhood, the restaurant itself didn't even have a sign really, we just wandered in.

chunks.speaker: B
chunks.text: Right, right, Alphama. We almost didn't go in because it looked closed from outside.

chunks.speaker: A
chunks.text: I know, and then the guy just waved us in through the side door like he'd been waiting for us specifically.

chunks.speaker: B
chunks.text: That whole trip was full of moments like that, honestly. Places that looked sketchy from outside and turned out to be the best meal of the day.

chunks.speaker: A
chunks.text: Totally. Anyway, so for the Cata Plana, I couldn't find the actual pan, the copper clam shell one, so I just used a regular Dutch oven.

chunks.speaker: B
chunks.text: Did that mess with the cooking at all, or was it basically fine?

chunks.speaker: A
chunks.text: It was mostly fine, I think the real pan trapped steam a little differently, but honestly the flavor was there. Garlic, white wine, the smoked sausage, tomatoes.

chunks.speaker: B
chunks.text: What kind of sausage did you use, because I remember the original had this really specific smoky thing going on?

chunks.speaker: A
chunks.text: I used chorizo, since I couldn't find Linguica anywhere near me. Close enough, honestly, maybe a little spicier than the original.

chunks.speaker: B
chunks.text: I actually like chorizo better in most things anyway, don't tell anyone from Portugal I said that.

chunks.speaker: A
chunks.text: Ha, your secret's safe. So I threw the clams in at the very end, covered it, let it steam for like six minutes.

chunks.speaker: B
chunks.text: That's the part I always get nervous about, timing the clams so they don't turn rubbery.

chunks.speaker: A
chunks.text: Same, but it worked out. They all opened up, nothing stayed shut, which I hear is the actual test of whether you did it right.

chunks.speaker: B
chunks.text: Yes, exactly, if a bunch of them stay closed you're supposed to toss those ones. Did that happen to you?

chunks.speaker: A
chunks.text: Maybe two out of like twenty. Not bad odds honestly.

chunks.speaker: B
chunks.text: That's a great ratio. Okay, now I'm hungry just talking about this. What did you serve it with?

chunks.speaker: A
chunks.text: Crusty bread, just to soak up the broth, and then this little side salad with oranges and olives, kind of a nod to that market we walked through.

chunks.speaker: B
chunks.text: The one near the water, right, with all the tiled stalls.

chunks.speaker: A
chunks.text: Yeah, that one. I keep thinking about the smell of that place, like citrus and grilled fish all mixed together.

chunks.speaker: B
chunks.text: Honestly that might be my favorite smell memory from the entire trip. Better than the bakery, even, and that bakery was unreal.

chunks.speaker: A
chunks.text: The custard tarts. I still dream about those custard tarts.

chunks.speaker: B
chunks.text: Don't even start, I tried to recreate them at home and it was a disaster. Burnt the sugar on top and the custard never set right.

chunks.speaker: A
chunks.text: Those things are deceptively hard. The crust alone takes forever to get flaky like that.

chunks.speaker: B
chunks.text: Yeah, I gave up after the second attempt and just accepted I'll only have good ones when we go back.

chunks.speaker: A
chunks.text: Speaking of going back, have you actually looked at flights at all, or was that just talk?

chunks.speaker: B
chunks.text: I looked, ha. Prices are actually not terrible if we go in the shoulder season, like late September or October.

chunks.speaker: A
chunks.text: That tracks with the weather too, it was so hot when we went in July, remember we basically hid indoors from like 1-4 every day.

chunks.speaker: B
chunks.text: I remember hiding in that little bookstore with the air conditioning that was way too strong for how hot it was outside.

chunks.speaker: A
chunks.text: That place was great though, I still have the book I bought there, never actually finished reading it.

chunks.speaker: B
chunks.text: Classic. Okay, if we go again, I want to actually make it out to that town everyone kept telling us to visit, the one with the castle on the hill.

chunks.speaker: A
chunks.text: Cintra, yeah, we ran out of time for that last time, which honestly still bugs me a little.

chunks.speaker: B
chunks.text: Same. We spent that whole extra day just wandering the city again instead of taking the train out there.

chunks.speaker: A
chunks.text: No regrets though, that was the day we found the little wine bar with the guy who kept giving us extra powers.

chunks.speaker: B
chunks.text: Oh my gosh, yes, he just kept topping off our glasses and pretending it was an accident.

chunks.speaker: A
chunks.text: I think he liked that we were so obviously enjoying ourselves. Either way, we left that place very happy.

chunks.speaker: B
chunks.text: Very happy is an understatement, we got lost trying to find our hotel afterward and it took like 40 minutes.

chunks.speaker: A
chunks.text: In our defence, those streets all look the same after a few glasses of Vinho Verde.

chunks.speaker: B
chunks.text: True. Okay, so if we go back, plan is, more time in Cintra, one more Cataplana dinner, and I'm making a real attempt at the custard tarts again with an actual recipe this time instead of guessing.

chunks.speaker: A
chunks.text: I fully support this plan. Should we also revisit that seafood rice place, the one with the line out front?

chunks.speaker: B
chunks.text: The line was so worth it though. That rice had this deep, almost smoky sweetness from the broth, I don't know how they got it that rich.

chunks.speaker: A
chunks.text: I think it's just hours of simmering with the shells and heads still in, honestly, that's usually the secret with stuff like that.

chunks.speaker: B
chunks.text: Makes sense. Okay, I'm sending you flight options tonight, I'm actually getting excited about this now.

chunks.speaker: A
chunks.text: Same, let's actually book something this time instead of just talking about it for six months.

chunks.speaker: B
chunks.text: Deal. And you have to bring the Cataplana recipe you used, I want to try it myself before we go, just so I have something to compare it to when we're actually there.

chunks.speaker: A
chunks.text: I'll text it to you tonight. Fair warning, my version has way more garlic than is probably traditional.

chunks.speaker: B
chunks.text: Good, more garlic is never a downside in my opinion.

chunks.speaker: A
chunks.text: Agreed completely. Alright, let's actually look at those dates tonight and stop talking about it in theory.

chunks.speaker: B
chunks.text: Deal, I'll call you later once I've got a couple options pulled up.

chunks.speaker: A
chunks.text: Oh, one more thing, we need to figure out where we're staying this time, because that last hotel was kind of a let down honestly.

chunks.speaker: B
chunks.text: The one with the tiny window that didn't actually open. I forgot about that until you just said it.

chunks.speaker: A
chunks.text: Yeah, and the shower had like zero water pressure the entire week. Nice location, but rough on the actual room.

chunks.speaker: B
chunks.text: I've been meaning to look for something in Alphama itself this time, even if it's a little pricier, just to be closer to everything we actually want to do.

chunks.speaker: A
chunks.text: That would be nice, honestly, waking up and just walking down those little streets instead of taking a cab everywhere.

chunks.speaker: B
chunks.text: Exactly, and it would put us closer to that wine bar too, which honestly might be the real motivation here.

chunks.speaker: A
chunks.text: Ha, fair, I won't pretend that's not part of it for me too. Okay, send me a couple of hotel options along with the flights tonight.

chunks.speaker: B
chunks.text: Will do. I'm also going to look into whether there's a food tour we can book in advance this time, since last time we just wandered and got lucky.

chunks.speaker: A
chunks.text: We did get lucky a lot, but a guided one might actually get us into places we'd never find on our own.

chunks.speaker: B
chunks.text: That's what I'm hoping. Alright, I really do need to run, but this got me way more excited than I expected for a random Tuesday.

chunks.speaker: A
chunks.text: Same, talk tonight once you've got the options together.

chunks.speaker: B
chunks.text: Sounds good, talk soon.
